nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances; token balances of holders, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, createTokens, refund and the constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowance store used by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
uint256 public totalSupply; total minted tokens, set in constructor, increased in createTokens, decreased in refund.
bool public isFinalized; crowdsale state flag guarding createTokens and refund and flipped in finalize.
uint256 public fundingStartBlock; lower block.number bound for createTokens.
uint256 public fundingEndBlock; upper block.number bound for createTokens, finalize and refund.
uint256 public tokenFund; pre-minted team tokens, computed in constructor from _tokenFund*10**decimals.
uint256 public tokenExchangeRate; tokens per wei, used in createTokens multiplication and refund division.
uint256 public tokenCreationCap; hard cap of totalSupply enforced in createTokens.
uint256 public tokenCreationMin; minimum sold supply required by finalize and checked by refund.
address public ethFundDeposit; recipient of withdrawn ETH and authorized caller of finalize.
address public tokenFundDeposit; receiver of pre-minted tokens and excluded from refunds.
uint256 public decimals; token precision, drives the 10**decimals scaling in the constructor.
string public name; ERC20 metadata assigned in the constructor.
string public symbol; ERC20 metadata assigned in the constructor.
msg.sender; attacker-controllable caller identity used as balance key, allowance key, and access-control subject.
constructor(...); initializes all crowdsale parameters and pre-mints tokenFund to tokenFundDeposit.
createTokens() payable external; accepts ETH during the funding window and mints tokens at tokenExchangeRate.
finalize() external; restricted to ethFundDeposit, marks the sale final and forwards the ETH balance.
refund() external; lets contributors burn tokens and reclaim ETH if the soft cap was not met.
transfer(address,uint256) public; moves tokens from msg.sender with SafeMath sub/add.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public; moves tokens using and decrementing the allowance.
approve(address,uint256) public; sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseApproval(address,uint) public; SafeMath add on the allowance.
decreaseApproval(address,uint) public; SafeMath sub on the allowance with a zero floor.
balanceOf(address) public view; returns balances[_owner].
allowance(address,address) public view; returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
totalSupply() public view; returns the totalSupply state variable.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) internal pure; checked multiplication with assert.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) internal pure; checked subtraction asserting b <= a.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) internal pure; checked addition asserting c >= a.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) internal pure; raw division, no zero-divisor guard.
balances[msg.sender] += tokens; raw unchecked addition in createTokens that bypasses SafeMath.
assert(ethFundDeposit.send(address(this).balance)); low-level ETH transfer from finalize.
assert(msg.sender.send(ethVal)); low-level ETH transfer to an attacker-supplied msg.sender in refund.
tokenFund = _tokenFund*10**decimals; raw unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
uint256 ethVal = tokenVal / tokenExchangeRate; division whose divisor is constructor-controlled.

constructor parameter _symbol.

_value parameter used by transfer, transferFrom and approve.

_addedValue parameter of increaseApproval.

uint256 tokens; tokens minted for msg.value in createTokens.
uint256 checkedSupply; totalSupply + tokens candidate cap check in createTokens.
uint256 tokenVal; caller balance snapshot in refund.
uint256 ethVal; ETH amount refunded to the caller.
uint oldValue; cached allowance in decreaseApproval.
